segments.title: Tom Proctor AIDS Run Memorial
segments.description: Family members and a reverend describe Tom Proctor's life and AIDS advocacy, with 500 runners raising funds for AIDS causes.
segments.transcript: Hi my name's Steve Proctor Welcome to the West Hollywood Tom Proctor 5 and 10K run Tom Proctor was my brother my younger brother He was born in 1950 He would have been about 38 years old now Uh Tom died on May 22 1986 of uh complications arising from AIDS Uh the last few months of his life were dedicated solely to the uh pursuit of aid for victims of AIDS and uh it was a cause very near and dear to his heart Uh today there are going to be about 500 runners running today with uh proceeds going to AIDS-related causes My name is Reverend Sandy Scott I am so proud to be here this morning This is my 2nd run I met Tom Proctor 3 years ago and he was my first amazing precious teacher in how to be with people with AIDS in the hospital He was out at County Hospital And I asked him told him I was a rookie I didn't know what to do I just wanted to help somehow and he said buy me plums and it was very hot and there was no air conditioning in his room and I will never forget the look of pleasure on his face and his shiny bright blue eyes when he bit into that plum and it actually brought him pleasure And uh we spent Christmas and Valentine's Day was very rainy in LA and we took this huge huge red heart to his hospital room And uh he it floated on the ceiling of his hospital room He wanted it on the ceiling so the 6 other guys in the ward could see it too That's the kind of guy he was He was generous He was my teacher He was my friend Um when I woke up this morning this is the only place I could possibly be to honor Tom and his amazing family His brother Steve's here and Barbara sister-in-law and his mother Lois and Bud his father He was my teacher He was my first teacher on how to be with people with AIDS and how you be with people with AIDS is how you be with anybody You just love him and loving Tom was one of the easiest most powerful impactful experiences I ever had Thank you Tom I love you forever

segments.title: Mayor Explains Tom Proctor Race
segments.description: West Hollywood mayor pro tem Abby Landon explains the origin and growth of the Tom Proctor 5K/10K AIDS fundraiser race.
segments.transcript: Hi uh I'm Abby Landon I'm mayor pro temp here in the city of West Hollywood And today is the annual 5K 10K Tom Proctor race and I'm sure as you can see we have a big turnout We it's called the Tom Proctor race Tom Proctor uh came up with the whole concept of doing the race a few years Years ago and he worked on the 1st race and he worked on the 2nd race and then he passed away from AIDS and so what we did in the city we wanted to somehow acknowledge all the wonderful work that he had done in the city so we named the race that he created after him and it's generated each year it's grown a little a little bit more and it's generated into an event that most people in the community really look forward to Well my name is Paul Koritz and I'm one of the city council members here in West Hollywood and last year I entered in the 5K and I was in about the same shape as I am this year which is to say not very good although at about the 1.5 mile mark I was beaten by a dog that pulled ahead of me And I thought of course I'd outlast the dog but I never came close never saw him again until the race was over So I thought this time I'd bring my own dog so I knew there was at least one at least was one dog in the race that I could beat
